next_step: Finish latency POC and run per-language recall sweep; security review signoff pending
blockers: data-residency confirmation for DE and FR regions
crm_notes: • Background: EU-headquartered knowledge management provider for legal and HR docs. Multi-national customer base; strict residency in DE and FR for some clients.
• Primary ask: production-grade RAG—embeddings index + reranking layer to surface high-precision results across 9 languages (EN, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PT, SV, PL).
• Scale: 120M documents (mixed PDFs, internal wikis, legacy DB dumps). Target index shard size ~2-5M docs/shard; initial rollout on a 30M doc subset for POC.

• Latency targets: 95th-perc end-to-end (embed+search+rerank) < 350ms for short queries (avg 16 tokens); tail budget 600ms. Throughput target: 350 qps for peak search traffic across regionally routed clusters.
• Cost sensitivity: unit target ~€0.003-0.007 per query at 350 qps steady state. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching, cache TTLs, quant profiles) to reach target.

• Model preferences: prefer open models with strong cross-lingual embedding quality. Want model variants per language family + a lighter reranker tuned for legal term precision. Consider fallback routing to lower-cost quantized models for non-sensitive queries.

• Evaluation approach: per-language recall/precision sweep using 12 labeled prompt-sets (legal-intent, clause-extraction, Q/A). Measuring embedding cosine thresholds, reranker calibration, and rerank latency per language.
• Security: must support customer-managed KMS, SSO (SAML) for Consoles, audit logs retained 2 years, and certs for DE/FR data residency. No external transcript exports for regulated clients.
• Timeline so far:
- 2025-10-02: inbound lead from webinar; initial qualification call (Maya).
- 2025-10-09: discovery workshop w/ product + infra; provided data volumetrics and language breakdown.
- 2025-10-21: NDA signed; shared sample dataset (30M subset) via secure bucket.
- 2025-11-03: Redwood SE ran initial embed quality run; preliminary MRR and recall numbers for EN/DE/FR uploaded to drive.
- 2025-11-09: POC kickoff call (linked_fireflies ff_20251109_verdant_initial_poc). Agreed on metrics and POC acceptance criteria.
- 2025-11-15: Canary latency tests with dedicated pool; 95p latency 420ms (above target) — likely network and reranker cold-start effects.
- 2025-11-18: Security questionnaire submitted; infra team requested private deployment details for KMS + residency.
• POC acceptance criteria (stated):
- >= 88% per-language MRR on labeled test sets for EN/DE/FR and >= 80% for remaining languages.
- 95p latency < 350ms for canonical queries, with documented fallback behavior if tail breached.
- Cost projection for steady-state at 350 qps <= €0.007/query after Optimize recommendations.
• Notes from calls:
- "Customer: 'We need results that lawyers can trust — precision over recall in clause extraction.'"
- SE: suggested reranker ensemble per-language + phrase-aware tokenization for German/compound nouns.
- Procurement: wants a dedicated contract; evaluating Dedicated vs Private (residency), leaning Private if KMS/residency validated.
• Open technical risks:
- Quantization regressions: OFA shows 2-4% drop in DE clause extraction F1 at int8 on current reranker baseline.
- Cross-lingual embeddings: need to validate hub-and-spoke index (language-agnostic hub embeddings + per-language fine-tuning) to avoid translation fallback artifacts.
- Indexing pipeline: pipeline must preserve OCR confidence and original language tokenization metadata for reranker features.
• Next immediate actions (owner):
- SE (Omar): run per-language reranker latency profiling with 3 quant profiles and upload results by 2025-11-24.
- AE (Maya): coordinate KMS/residency call with Security on 2025-11-25; provide procurement with dedicated contract template.
- CSM (Priya): draft onboarding checklist and per-language eval harness; start playbook for multilingual rollouts.

• Short summary: High-value enterprise prospect for Redwood Dedicated/Private. Strong technical match but residency & per-language recall tuning are blockers. POC results in next 2 weeks will determine contract path.
• Quick CRM snippet for outreach: 'Follow up after SE per-lang latency runs — share Optimize runbook and cost projection. Ask procurement for residency proof of concept window.'
